claim_text: Four defendants across three 2023-docketed cases, previously listed in this corpus only as 'charged,' pleaded guilty per a Hiiraan Online tracker: Ayan Farah Abukar (case 23-CR-80; founder of Action for East African People) pleaded guilty to one count of conspiracy to commit wire fraud, admitting she received about $5.7 million in federal funds and paid more than $330,000 in kickbacks to a Feeding Our Future employee, spending proceeds on a Lakeville commercial property and an aircraft in Kenya; Mohamed Ali Hussein and Lul Bashir Ali (case 23-CR-91, both of Faribault) each pleaded guilty to one count of wire fraud, jointly admitting to defrauding the government of more than $5 million through Hussein's nonprofit Somali American Faribault Education and Ali's restaurant Lido Restaurant, and jointly agreed to repay that amount and forfeit three properties and one car; Mulata Yusuf Ali (case 23-CR-92; operator of Franklyn Transportation LLC) pleaded guilty to one count of aiding and abetting the theft of public money, admitting he was paid close to $100,000 to let others launder more than $2 million through his business's bank account, with a plea-agreement guideline sentence of 24 to 30 months and $95,099 in restitution.

supporting_passages.quote: Mulata Ali... pleaded guilty to one count of aiding and abetting in the theft of public money... Mulata's plea agreement calls for a guideline sentence of 24 to 30 months in prison and a payment of $95,099 in restitution

amounts.methodology: Mulata Yusuf Ali's plea-agreement restitution figure, per Hiiraan Online; not yet confirmed against a primary judgment.
Amount Ayan Farah Abukar admitted receiving in federal funds, per Hiiraan Online.
Joint restitution figure ('more than $5 million') agreed by Mohamed Ali Hussein and Lul Bashir Ali per Hiiraan Online; a single joint obligation, not two separate $5 million amounts.

qualifiers: No primary court record has been captured for any of these four defendants; all dispositions rest on a single secondary journalism source.
No exact plea dates are given for any of the four in the retrieved source text.
The $5 million restitution obligation for Mohamed Ali Hussein and Lul Bashir Ali is joint, not additive; do not sum it twice across their two defendant records.
This claim does not resolve Sade Osman Hashi (23-CR-81), who does not appear by name in this source and remains 'charged' pending further research.
